recheck.issue: review 2 variant 3 why: 'a difference smaller than its own interval is a tie' is the wrong rule
recheck.reason: The tie criterion is an interval that includes zero (facts regression.paired_method); a difference can be smaller than its interval's width and still exclude zero (uncertainty.difference_logreg_minus_boosting_95 = [0.002, 0.015] around 0.009).
recheck.change: why now reads 'When the interval around a difference includes zero, the two are tied, so the score does not decide this one.' The stem already says the interval comfortably includes zero, so the key is unchanged.
